description: my famous sugar cookie recipe 🤍 These will be the best sugar cookies you will ever taste in your life. Soft, chewy and just overall delicious. Recipe: Wet Ingredients * 1 cup unsalted butter, melted and cooled * 1 2/3 cups white granulated sugar * 2 large eggs * 1 tsp vanilla extract Dry Ingredients * 2 1/2 cups all purpose flour * 1 tsp baking soda * 1/2 tsp baking powder * 1/4 tsp salt Bake Temperature: 350F or 180C Bake Time: 11-12 minutes 1. Preheat oven to 350F. 2. Add flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt to bowl. Mix and set aside. 3. Add butter and sugar to bowl. Cream for 2-3 minutes. 4. Add eggs and vanilla extract. Mix. 5. Combine wet and dry ingredients. 6. Cool in fridge for 10-15 minutes. 7. In a bowl, add some sugar to toss cookies in. 8. Scoop dough and toss in sugar.  9. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 11-12 minutes on 350F. 10. Once done, cool for 10 minutes and enjoy 🫶🏽.
